secrets.name: BASE44_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.description: Base44 account access token (JWT). Find it in ~/.base44/auth/auth.json after running `base44 login` on your own machine, or via the Base44 dashboard. The CLI seeds auth from this env var, replacing interactive `base44 login`.

secrets.name: BASE44_REFRESH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Base44 account refresh token, paired with the access token. Found alongside it in ~/.base44/auth/auth.json after `base44 login`.

secrets.name: BASE44_APP_ID
secrets.description: The Base44 app id for this project. Found in the Builder URL (app.base44.com/apps/<id>/...). Used by `base44 link --app-id` to connect this clone to the app.
